sources.claim: HTML event loop runs tasks, performs microtask checkpoints, and may update rendering; rendering is not an ordinary task in a single FIFO.
Microtasks are drained until empty, including microtasks enqueued by other microtasks.
Node nextTick and Promise microtask ordering depends on execution context, including CommonJS versus ESM.
Atomics provides sequentially consistent atomic operations for shared integer typed arrays.
Atomics.wait and notify coordinate agents over shared memory; main-thread restrictions are host-specific.
Intl.Segmenter can segment strings by grapheme cluster and exposes source indices.
Grapheme cluster boundaries follow Unicode text segmentation rules and differ from code point boundaries.
Vue 3.5 line includes reactivity refactoring and subsequent 3.5.44 maintenance release; 3.6 is release-candidate line as of verification date.
Vue stable and prerelease tags are separately listed; latest stable was 3.5.44 on 2026-10-13.
Stable keys let React match list items across insertion, deletion, and reorder.
Keyed list updates preserve node identity and state across list changes.
getSnapshot must return a cached immutable snapshot and remain referentially stable when the store is unchanged.
Array iteration provides indexed positions that can be retained as structured validation paths.
Validation errors should be associated with controls using accessible state and descriptions.
Generator return completes iteration and permits generator finally cleanup semantics.
AbortSignal exposes cancellation state to cooperating code; it cannot interrupt arbitrary synchronous execution.
JavaScript object nodes can be linked by references; removed-node references remain reachable unless cleared.
Map preserves key identity and can store graph node visitation and predecessor state.
TypeScript 7.0 is the released native compiler line announced on 2026-07-08.
Combobox keyboard behavior and active descendant relationships are specified as an interaction pattern.
Active descendant accessibility relationships depend on an element id and browser accessibility mapping.
Size container queries target the nearest eligible ancestor and require a declared containment context.
inline-size containment isolates the inline dimension and can affect intrinsic sizing.
sources.version: CSS Conditional Rules Level 5 / MDN current page

sources.claim: Transforms and other ancestor properties can establish containing blocks for positioned descendants.
preload requests a resource for the current navigation and resource type affects matching and reuse.
sources.version: HTML Standard / MDN current page accessed 2026-10-13

sources.claim: prefetch is a browser hint for likely future navigation and is not a guaranteed request.
React 19.3.0 was listed as latest stable on 2026-10-13.
React 19.3 release announcement is dated 2026-09-09.
React Server Components require bundler or framework integration and are not a standalone deployment recipe.
React 19 release notes describe Server Components support as framework/bundler-facing infrastructure.
TypeScript 7.0 stable announcement describes the Go native port and side-by-side 6.0 compatibility strategy.
TypeScript 6.0 is a transition release aligning deprecations and behavior ahead of TypeScript 7.0.
TypeScript 7.0 has moved from upcoming roadmap to released version.
Promise.race settles from the first settled input and does not cancel remaining operations.
AbortController communicates cancellation to APIs that opt into AbortSignal.
Fetch rejects for network failures and aborts, while HTTP error status is represented by a Response object.
ReadableStream readers expose cancellation and lock release operations.
Array methods have per-method browser and runtime compatibility data.
TypedArray byteOffset and byteLength are byte units while indexed access is element based.
DataView reads and writes at byte offsets with an explicit endianness option.
React 19.3.0 was latest stable on the verification date.
React 19.2 introduced Activity, useEffectEvent and Performance Tracks.
Effect cleanup runs before setup with changed dependencies and on unmount; Strict Mode adds a development stress cycle.
startTransition marks state updates as non-blocking; synchronous callback work is not moved to another thread.
React 19.2 performance tracks expose scheduler work in Chrome DevTools recordings.
Vue compiler emits patch flags and static hoists that let runtime optimize vnode updates.
Vue 3.5 introduced useTemplateRef.
Template refs are available after mount and refer to rendered DOM or component instances.
TypeScript module resolution models bundler and Node runtimes; paths does not rewrite emitted imports.
Form submission constructs an entry list from successful controls; requestSubmit follows submission and validation steps.
